key.name: poll-interval
key.description: Milliseconds between telemetry updates from the Rust daemon.

key.name: animate-popover
key.description: Play a calm fade-and-scale animation when the popover opens and closes.

key.name: compact-mode
key.description: Replace the panel gauges with a single status dot.

key.name: mono-palette
key.description: Use a single accent color for the ring gauges instead of the load-based color spectrum.

key.name: pause-away
key.description: Pause telemetry sampling while the machine is locked or idle, saving power and CPU.

key.name: show-cpu
key.description: Show the CPU gauge and details.

key.name: show-ram
key.description: Show the RAM gauge and details.

key.name: show-fan
key.description: Show the cooling fan gauge and details (auto-detects 1 or more fans).

key.name: show-cpu-temp
key.description: Show the CPU package temperature next to the CPU percentage.

key.name: show-history
key.description: Show a ~30 second CPU history overview in the popover.

key.name: show-gpu
key.description: Show the GPU section in the popover.

key.name: show-network
key.description: Show the network throughput graphs in the popover.

key.name: show-disk
key.description: Show the disk throughput graphs in the popover.

key.name: show-processes
key.description: Show the top CPU-consuming processes in the popover.

key.name: glass-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the Liquid Glass popover background.

key.name: widget-order
key.description: Comma-separated list of widget ids defining their display order.

key.name: glass-corner-radius
key.summary: Corner radius of the Liquid Glass popover in pixels.
